As of the latest available information in September 2015, there was no indication of a partial or full lift of the embargo before the August 6, 2016 deadline [4]. Given the explicit one-year extension and the lack of any announced policy reversal, it is highly unlikely that Russia would lift any part of the embargo before the specified date.
